'''2000 European Championship Booster Draft''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held in Brussels, Belgium on 12 August 2000. [[Johan Haneveer]] won it. It is known from Maarten Rossou's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1142">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-pietreport-europeancontinental-13-8-00d1142/ pietreport-europeancontinental-13-8-00], DeckTech (Maarten "PIET" Rossou, 18 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-pietreport-europeancontinental-13-8-00d1142/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 European Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Brussels, Belgium
* '''Format:''' [[Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Johan Haneveer]]
